messages:
ben-sales: Hey team — POC with AcmeRetail streaming keeps hanging when proxied through their corp gateway. They see 504s and long stalls, client retries spike and downstream duplicates requests. Need quick triage, customer on call this afternoon.
sean-eng: can you paste a short log snippet? is this streaming SSE or chunked HTTP/1.1?
ben-sales: chunked HTTP/1.1 streaming from our TS SDK. Sample from their LB: 
```
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] GET /v1/stream -> 200, started chunked transfer
[2026-03-19T14:02:21Z] proxy: upstream idle timeout
[2026-03-19T14:02:21Z] HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
```
They say Node client then retries and app receives duplicated first partial chunk.
nana-ps: pinging @sean-eng and @raj-devex. common culprits: proxy idle timeout, broken keepalive pools, or proxy treating long-lived connection as stalled and closing mid-stream.
raj-devex: quick checklist: 1) confirm SDK set keepAlive agent; 2) disable proxy connection reuse if proxy shards incorrectly; 3) set small application-level heartbeat/event to keep connection active.
kyle-sre-bot: Incident note created: ID IR-2026-0423-ACME-STREAM. Auto-attach logs from prod-sim cluster.
sean-eng: from TS SDK perspective try: 
```js
const https = require('https');
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 2 });
fetch(url, { agent, headers: { 'Connection': 'keep-alive' } });
```
also set `timeout: 0` for stream reads (don't prematurely abort) and implement `idempotency-key` for retries so downstream can detect duplicates.
customer-akshay: we set HTTP_PROXY= http://corp-proxy:8080 and NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1. Proxy team says their gateway proxies CONNECT but drops idle connections after 10s.
ben-sales: can we recommend a workaround we can ask customer to try before call?
nana-ps: ask them to: 
- enable keepalive on client (see agent snippet)
- lower proxy idle to client heartbeat every 5s (send tiny event) OR disable proxy pooling for that route
- set retry backoff and `Idempotency-Key` header so retries are safe
- try curl to reproduce: `curl -v -x http://corp-proxy:8080 -N \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream\"`
raj-devex: also add a proxy-level config to not buffer streaming responses (some proxies switch to buffering mode and then time out). If they can't change proxy, we can: 1) switch to short-polling (not ideal) or 2) use our dedicated relay in a nearby region to terminate the streaming and re-broadcast over a stable tunnel.
jess-ps: pricing/offer note — if we recommend dedicated relay for POC traffic, include one-month free credit and engineering assist. Ask sales if they want to propose that.
sean-eng: logs from their reproduction run show repeated `socket hang up` at the client when proxy sends `504`. Suggest instrumenting client to log connection id and sequence so we can correlate duplicates. Example header we can read: `x-redwood-stream-id: <uuid>` and include `x-idempotency-key` per request.
customer-akshay: we can add heartbeat from app but would prefer server fix. Could you show sample server-side tiny-event format?
raj-devex: sample tiny event: `\n:heartbeat\n\n` (SSE ping) or a zero-length chunk `\n` for chunked. Our server accepts either.
ben-sales: I put the call on calendar 30m. Action items: sean to draft quick steps + agent snippet, raj to prepare heartbeat sample and fallback plan (relay option), jess to draft POC credit note. kyle-sre-bot to attach IR.
sean-eng: will post a short debug checklist in thread in 10m and include `curl` reproducer and Node/Python examples.
kyle-sre-bot: Attached logs from prod-sim: /attachments/IR-2026-0423-ACME-STREAM/logs.tar.gz (linked).
customer-akshay: thanks — will try keepAlive and heartbeat now, will report before call. :thumbsup:
ben-sales: thanks all, if customer still sees duplicate chunks we may enable idempotency checks server-side for the POC to avoid duplicates while we sort proxy.
